speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Master Shakespeare? Cuthbert Burbage. From Holywell.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Cuthbert. I am in. You have not come for a part.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Allen rode in from Essex today. I have been with him about the ground. Two years less a month till the lease falls in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two years less a month. Your father says two years, when he says it at all.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: He was civil. He named his figure. Four-and-twenty pound a year, where we pay fourteen, for a short extension. There is a clause about the house after five years. He would not explain it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four-and-twenty against fourteen. And a clause he will not read.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: My father says he'll pull the house down. I say, let's first ask what the timber's worth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Has he said the figure in the house.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: He has not. I want the sharers to know it before he tells it his own way on Monday. And I want you in particular to keep him from cursing Allen to his face.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have never seen Allen. What is a new play worth to a landlord.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Nothing. To my father, a year.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I'll tell him I've a king coming.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Tell him it's long. God keep you.
